editorial:
Imagine throwing a surprise party for your local priest in the quiet English countryside, only for it to turn into a total nightmare. That is exactly what happens here. After opening a birthday card, the priest finds a note saying everyone has been poisoned and has only sixty minutes left to live. Suddenly, a friendly get-together turns into a wild scramble for survival. You get to watch these friends turn on each other as they panic and try to find an antidote, which really shows how quickly people can snap when they are scared for their lives.

What makes this really cool is that the whole thing is shot in one single take, which makes you feel like you are trapped in the room with them. The UK actors do a great job making the panic feel real. While it is a bit low-budget, the tension keeps you glued to your seat. If you enjoy tight thrillers with big twists, you should definitely check this out. It looks best if you can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for all the detail, or you can just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: As the timer runs out, the group discovers that the killer was actually one of the guests hiding in plain sight. The twist reveals that the poisoning was a way to force everyone to confess their darkest secrets. In the final moments, the truth comes out about past betrayals and lies. Most of the group does not survive, leaving you with a grim reminder that you never truly know the people living right next door to you.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves locked-room mysteries and psychological thrillers.
